description: Physical print only; 131 identities retained. Decision-led positional, Command and effect balance pass; native/Webgame remains unchanged.

effects.text: You may move another friendly formation in this Front one row toward its Frontline into an empty legal position.

replacements.design_note: Immediate Frontline reinforcement.

effects.text: Give this Force Empowered.
If the opposing Frontline in this Front is empty, this Force's basic Archer Attack may target an opposing Middle Force.
effects.exposed: ARCHER · May target Middle through gap

replacements.design_note: Archer entry boon lets one Attack ignore Guard screening; keeps special Middle targeting.

effects.text: You may move this formation one position into an adjacent active empty position, if legal.

replacements.design_note: Deployment tempo for reduced Strength.

effects.text: While in Middle, this Force screens the friendly Rear Force from basic Archer Attacks even while Shaken, but not while Depleted.
effects.exposed: Screens Rear even if Shaken; not Depleted

replacements.design_note: Screening resilience with Depleted counterplay.

effects.text: If played into an empty Middle position, you may swap this formation with the friendly Frontline formation here, if both placements are legal.

replacements.design_note: One-time frontline relief; still obey occupancy restrictions.

effects.text: You may Move an opposing Frontline formation in this Front one row toward Rear, if legal and empty.

replacements.design_note: Wolf Skirmishers no longer depend on an Archer. Standardized phrasing; intended mechanics unchanged.

effects.text: While this formation is Bonded, opposing card effects cannot move it.
effects.exposed: Enemy card effects cannot move this formation

replacements.design_note: Exposed Bond movement protection.

effects.text: You may choose an opposing Bonded Formation in this Front. Return its Bond to its owner's hand.

replacements.design_note: Raid an opponent's formation layer.

effects.text: If playing this Bond completes a Named Formation, give that formation +2 Strength this Battle. Otherwise, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Strong completion burst replaces free Maneuver, while preparing the Bond still provides card selection; no replay on later attachment.

effects.text: Choose a friendly Force in this Front, if any. Give it Inspired.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: A prepared Endured With still protects an existing friendly Force in its Front, rather than wasting its PLAY effect.

effects.text: While this formation is Bonded, its Name text cannot be suppressed.

replacements.design_note: Exposed Bond name-text protection.

effects.text: While this formation is Bonded, it may Maneuver without being Named.

replacements.design_note: Exposed Bond mobility.

effects.text: Draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on top of your deck.

replacements.design_note: One-shot card-flow instead of blank +0 Bond.

effects.text: Look at your opponent's hand. You may then move this formation one position into an adjacent active empty position, if legal.

replacements.design_note: Information followed by positioning.

effects.text: At resolution, if your Frontline is empty, Move one friendly Middle formation into it, if legal. Give that formation +2 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: One-time +2 and row transfer at resolution has a real setup and hidden-plan Action cost. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: Choose a friendly King or Captain and another friendly formation in its Front. Give that other formation +1 Strength this Battle; you may Move it one adjacent legal empty position.

replacements.design_note: Leadership Order supplies one meaningful temporary Strength before optional mobility.

effects.text: At resolution, if only you have a Named Formation here: on a tie, win if still tied after reveals; if behind by 1, give one of your Named Formations here +2 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Close Fronts matter, including a one-point loss. Eligibility is checked only once against the pre-reveal totals.

effects.text: When an opposing Tactic targets your formation here, ignore its effect on that formation. Alternatively, prevent one affliction from an opposing Attack on your Force here.

replacements.design_note: Wider defensive trap: protects against one hostile Tactic or an Attack affliction in the assigned Front, not both. The reveal consumes the one plan.

effects.text: At resolution, if you have a King or Captain here, give up to two other friendly formations here +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: 2 temporary Strength on two other formations still requires a King/Captain and a set Stratagem Action. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: At resolution, if this is an outer Front, give one friendly Archer, Guard or Stronghold formation here +2 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Assigned-Front Stratagem phrasing. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: After your Raider or Skirmisher gives an opposing Force here a negative marker, return one of that Force's attached Bonds or Names to its owner's hand.

replacements.design_note: 2C positional ambush replaces transient +2 with attachment disruption after actual pressure. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: After one of your Riders moves into or out of this Front, it may Move one additional adjacent legal position and gets +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: A Rider movement chain with positional and Strength consequences. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: When your formation here becomes Named, either Move it up to two adjacent legal empty positions or return an opposing attached Bond here to its owner's hand.

replacements.design_note: Named completion creates either a repositioning or an attachment-raid threat. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: At resolution, if you have a King or Captain, give up to three other friendly Human formations across this Front and one adjacent active Front +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Leadership projects strength across a Front boundary, rather than cloning cheaper Center Must Hold. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: After an opposing Force Attacks here, one of your Archers here that has not Attacked may make a legal basic Archer Attack for free. Mark its Attack used.

replacements.design_note: A triggered counterattack instead of a temporary Strength bonus. Assigned Front is implicit per physical rulebook; reveal eligibility unchanged.

effects.text: When your opponent sets a Stratagem here and you have a Scout or Seer here, look at that Stratagem. Give one friendly Force here Guarded.

replacements.design_note: Foreknowledge now creates actual protective counterplay; requires a Scout/Seer and a newly set plan.

effects.text: Each friendly Hero formation or Named Formation gets +1 Strength this Battle, once per formation even if both.

replacements.design_note: One application per formation, other card effects still stack.

effects.text: This Force may Maneuver without being Named.
This Force may Maneuver while Exhausted.

replacements.design_note: Retire the player-facing MOBILE and TIRELESS headers without altering movement permissions.

effects.text: If you play this Force into Frontline, give the friendly Force directly behind it Guarded, if there is one.

replacements.design_note: A committed Frontline spear protecting a supporting rank; 2C/4S Guard retains a tradeoff against unrestricted Red Shields.

effects.text: If the opposing Frontline here is empty, choose an opposing Middle or Rear Force here and give it Depleted.

replacements.design_note: Frontline-only breakthrough; only useful when a gap is already open, unlike persistent Command-stealing Reavers.

effects.text: If an opposing Frontline Force is in this Front, give it Shaken.

replacements.design_note: Frontline-only entry shock; different from unrestricted Rider/Skirmisher Dust Riders.

effects.text: Choose a friendly Force. Remove its Exhaustion, if present.
Move up to two different friendly formations one orthogonally adjacent legal position each.

replacements.design_note: Recovery followed by an optional coordinated redeployment.

effects.text: Choose an opposing Force in a Front containing one of your Archers. Exhaust it.
Choose an opposing Exhausted Force in a Front containing your Archer. Give it Shaken.

replacements.design_note: Immediate Archer pressure plus optional second-Action Shaken payoff.

effects.text: Choose a friendly formation. Give it +1 Strength this Battle. You may Move it one legal orthogonally adjacent position.
While you control a Seer, your Named Formations in a Front containing one of your Seers or an adjacent active Front get +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Seer support rewards actual Named Strength near their position; movement remains optional and supporting, without changing flank geometry.

effects.text: Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
Your Tactics targeting cards or formations in a Front with your Raider or Skirmisher cost 1 less Command (minimum 0). Afterward, you may Move one of those troops one legal position.

replacements.design_note: Modest immediate card selection plus existing tactical discount and reposition engine.

effects.text: Choose up to two friendly Rider formations in active Fronts. Each gets +1 Strength this Battle.
Your Riders may Maneuver without being Named and pay 0 Command to Maneuver this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Riders gain a tangible 1–2 Strength payoff alongside optional zero-Command unnamed mobility.

effects.text: Give one friendly Guard or Stronghold Guarded.
Your Guards and Strongholds in Middle give the friendly Rear formation directly behind each of them +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Two-Action movement exception replaced with an immediate Boon plus persistent positional defensive Strength.

effects.text: Choose one friendly Force. Remove one temporary negative marker from it, if present, then give it Inspired.

replacements.design_note: 1C ongoing defense Narrative introduces underused Inspired and can work even without a removable marker.

effects.text: Choose a friendly Force in this Front, if any. Give it Guarded.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Guarded can protect a friendly Force elsewhere in its Front when played prepared; cannot target an inactive Front.

effects.text: Look at one opposing face-down Stratagem in any active Front. You may then draw 1 card and discard 1 card.

replacements.design_note: Replace permanent global hidden-plan surveillance with a paid Action and one useful sift per Battle.

effects.text: While in Rear, other friendly Archer formations in this Front get +1 Strength.
effects.exposed: REAR · Other Archers in this Front +1 Strength

replacements.design_note: Rear Archer/Scout promotes another Archer's persistent Front Strength rather than only inspecting hidden Stratagems. Requires a second Archer in the same Front.

effects.text: Once per Battle, when your opponent sets a Stratagem in this Front while this formation is in Middle or Rear, you may look at it, then draw 1 card and discard 1 card.

replacements.design_note: Cheap local scouting provides card filtering, not repeatable omniscient inspection.

effects.text: Regain 2 Command.
Choose another friendly Human formation in this Front. The next Bond or Name you play onto it this turn costs 2 less Command (minimum 0). Draw 1 card.

replacements.design_note: 4C King leader creates an actual two-Action attachment turn, with meaningful hand/cost swing.

effects.text: Choose an opposing Rear Force. Exhaust it, then give it Shaken.

replacements.design_note: 2C one-shot now affects Strength as well as movement; Shaken counterplay via Inspired.

effects.text: In a Front containing your Raider, choose an opposing prepared Bond or Name, or the Bond of an opposing Depleted Force. Its owner pays 2 Command or returns that component to hand.

replacements.design_note: Depleted gains a targeted logistical risk; prepared cards remain vulnerable.

effects.text: Attach a prepared Bond or Name from here or an adjacent active Front to the formation directly ahead, if legal. If it becomes Named, it gets +2 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: one-shot logistics now rewards arranging a prepared component to complete a Named Formation with +2 temporary Strength.

effects.text: In a Front containing your Captain, either swap two adjacent friendly formations (if legal) or discard one friendly Force there with its Bond and Name to regain 2 Command.

replacements.design_note: Explicit sacrifice releases one persistent position for an Action, at the cost of Force Strength and attached layers.

effects.text: When an opponent sets a Stratagem in or adjacent to a Front containing your Scout or Ship, look at it. Give one friendly formation in the Stratagem's Front +2 Strength this Battle, if any.

replacements.design_note: Intelligence reacts with material +2 Front Strength rather than small movement. Requires an existing Scout/Ship in the Stratagem Front or its neighbor.
5 Strength at 2 Command and no ability: high per-position baseline versus specialist Guards/Raiders. Flag for playtest; no class/combat tricks.

effects.text: While this formation is Bonded and in Frontline, this Bond contributes +1 additional Strength and this formation cannot be flanked.

replacements.design_note: Trade the Named-only +1 of Followed for Frontline-only +1 and protection from flanking and Rider targeting; other ranks gain neither.

effects.text: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
As this Action, play a Bond from your hand onto a friendly formation with no Bond in this Front. Pay 1 less Command (minimum 0). If that play completes a Named Formation, draw 1 card.

replacements.design_note: A real alternative to ordinary Bond play: 1 Command discount and a card on successful completion, for the same Action. Limited once per Battle.

effects.text: Exchange the Bonds of two friendly Bonded Formations in any active Fronts. Each of those formations that remains Named gets +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: One Action and 2 Command for an immediate formation exchange and up to two temporary Strength; no repeatable two-Action setup.

effects.text: Attach a prepared Bond or Name in this Front to the friendly formation directly ahead, if legal.
Attach up to two prepared Bonds or Names to friendly formations in this Front, one at a time. Give Guarded to each formation that becomes Named this way.
effects.exposed: ACTION · 1/B: attach up to 2 prepared; newly Named Guarded

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: a useful on-play attachment plus one major once-per-Battle two-layer commitment and Guarded completion reward.

effects.text: Choose a prepared Name in this Front. Attach it to a friendly Force here with an empty Name slot, if legal.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Play effect works when Stayed Behind For is itself prepared or attached to any Force; no future PLAY reactivation.

effects.text: If you control a Rider or Scout formation in this Front, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Prepared Kept Pace With can still filter if a Rider or Scout already exists in its Front.

effects.text: If you control a Captain or Scout formation in this Front, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Card-flow Bond works when prepared near an existing Captain or Scout, not only when immediately attached.

effects.text: If you control a Raider or Skirmisher formation here and an opposing Force in this Front is Exhausted, your opponent loses 1 Command and you regain the amount actually lost.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Prepared layer can exploit an Exhausted enemy via a separate friendly Raider/Skirmisher; supports Phase 2 Exhaustion payoff without added damage.

effects.text: Choose a friendly formation in this Front, if any. It gets +1 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Phase 3: Simple temporary Strength tempo for a Bond played attached or prepared, replacing low-payoff gratuitous movement.

effects.text: Exchange your cards between two adjacent active Fronts, rank for rank, if legal. Prepared layers and markers move with them. Give one moved Named Formation +2 Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Strange full-Front transformation resolves on PLAY rather than requiring another ACTION; rank restrictions respected, +2 rewards committed Named stacks.

effects.text: Choose an opposing Force in a Front with your Scout. If it is Exhausted, give it Shaken. Otherwise, Exhaust it.

replacements.design_note: Scouting Tactic meaningfully converts already Exhausted targets into −2 Shaken, otherwise delivers −1 Exhausted.

effects.text: Return an opposing prepared Bond or Name to its owner's hand. Alternatively, return an opposing attached Bond in a Front containing your Scout or Seer to its owner's hand.

replacements.design_note: Preparation punish remains, but Scouts/Seers can also sabotage a completed formation.

effects.text: Choose an opposing Frontline or Middle Force in a Front containing your Scout or Skirmisher. Move it one row toward Rear, if legal and empty. Otherwise, give it Shaken.

replacements.design_note: A positional dilemma: an eligible opponent yields space or takes −2 and loses Guard screening, but only under Scout/Skirmisher pressure.

effects.text: Choose an opposing formation. Its ACTION abilities cannot be used this Battle. If Named, its Name contributes no Strength this Battle.

replacements.design_note: Suppresses ACTION abilities but remains useful against Named stacks through lost Name modifier.

effects.text: Choose an opposing Frontline or Middle Force in a Front containing your Skirmisher. Move it one row toward Rear, if legal and empty. If it moves, give it Depleted.

replacements.design_note: Requires a real legal displacement to apply Depleted (−1 and disabled formation ACTIONs), giving the 0C Tactic a tactical payoff with counterplay.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 5 Strength plus strong two-unit PLAY buff and King access
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: King Name immediately regains 2 Command and offers a once-per-Battle classification-wide Strength bonus

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Scout with once-per-Battle two-step Move (Action required)
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Limited information is worth less than regular Names' more reliable combat or card benefits; a Hero Name also occupies the one-per-Battle Hero slot.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 5-Strength Raider with PLAY tax/hand-return attack on prepared layers
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name suppresses an attached effect on completion and can impose a one-use local Tax

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Guard with continuous Tactic-cost screening for its rank
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: A one-time conditional marker cleanse and redirect compares more closely to 2C protection Names than to a 3C persistent engine.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 2-Strength Steward draws 2 and discards 1 when played
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name regains 2 Command and provides persistent global Bond/Name price reductions

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Force attaches a prepared layer immediately
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name recovers a discarded Bond and attaches prepared layers once per Battle

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 4-Strength Rider with a free-Command once-per-Battle Move Action
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name repositions an ally on completion and has a once-per-Battle Move Action

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 4-Strength Force clears a harmful marker on entry
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Name protects itself from suppression and makes opposing targeted Tactics cost more

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 3-Strength Seer offers strong on-PLAY top-three deck selection
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Narrative recursion requires a suitable discard and further Actions; it has a weaker opening-Battle floor than other 3C Names.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 4-Strength King/Archer with a Bonded +1 Strength condition
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: The transient Archer buff and paid -1 Strength Action underperform 2C Corin's persistent Archer support in many positions.

hero_mode_costs.force_rationale: 5-Strength Force gains a persistent +1 when Bonded and Frontline
hero_mode_costs.name_rationale: Regain 1 Command and Tactic-specific Strength protection compares directly to Edrin's 1C regain and broader one-use affliction prevention.

strength_adjustments.reason: Conditional healer Action needs another Action and an afflicted Force ahead; +1 printed Strength restores a viable default body without changing the effect or cost.
Middle-only passive for an already Exhausted and otherwise Maneuver-eligible Force is a rare setup; +1 Strength compensates its narrow floor.
Middle-only, Named-only Tactic tax against other formations has a late and uncertain trigger; +1 Strength restores a useful default contribution.
One optional reaction to a same-Front hidden Stratagem per Battle is too intermittent for a 2-Strength 3C Force; +1 Strength ensures value without a Stratagem.

edge_cue_policy: Print layout only: upper-right text reminds players when to consult the card body; never summarises rules, outcomes, costs or Strength. Text is CHECK + short trigger. Do not insert timing/condition icon glyphs.
